'''Ethnikos Achna Football Club''' ({{langx|el|Αθλητικός Σύλλογος Εθνικός Άχνας}}), commonly known as '''Ethnikos Achna''' or simply '''Ethnikos''', is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the village of [[Dasaki Achnas]] in [[Akrotiri and Dhekelia]], on the island of [[Cyprus (island)|Cyprus]]. Founded in 1968, the club currently plays in the [[Cypriot First Division]]. Ethnikos' home ground is the [[Dasaki Stadium]], which can accommodate 7,000 spectators."}}
